description: Get NRFA gauging-station metadata, river, location and catchment area to identify a historical flow record. Supply the numeric NRFA station_id; use nrfa_get_timeseries for observations. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

station_id.description: Positive numeric NRFA gauging-station identifier; not an EA station ID.

name: nrfa_station_info
